questions.question: In your Navy System for Naval Target Control work, how did you translate software requirements into test scripts and maintain the Requirements Verification Traceability Matrix?
Describe a defect you investigated in a C++, C#, or Visual Basic application. How did you isolate the cause, validate the fix, and document the result?
You have modified proprietary testing tools in multiple roles. Walk us through one improvement you made, the problem it solved, and how you verified it improved the testing process.
What experience do you have creating automated test scripts with TestComplete, TestExecute, C#, or Visual Basic, and how did you decide which tests to automate?
This role leads multiple Agile teams using Jira and Confluence. Based on your Jira experience, how have you tracked defects, test execution, release readiness, and hot fixes?
Describe your experience supporting release activities, including the engineering builds you prepared for external developers and customers and the weekly hot fixes you performed.
What was your role in setting up automation testing for the five stand-alone programs on the JTCG/ME contract? What technical or process challenges did you encounter?

This position requires hands-on understanding of relational and non-relational databases. Tell us about your experience assisting with SQL Server 2014 and how you used database knowledge during testing or troubleshooting.

The role involves managing and mentoring a team of 15–20 people. Drawing on your experience as an Army Team Leader and on software teams, how would you organize work, maintain accountability, and support team morale?
